run_f_gold: run f_gold with an integer N to compute possible ways to construct buildings
test_f_gold: test f_gold against f_filled using the built-in test harness with 10 parameter sets
summarize_f_gold: summarize the f_gold function that uses a Fibonacci-like recurrence to count building construction ways
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use memoization or matrix exponentiation for large N values
review_f_gold: review f_gold to understand the countB and countS state transitions for building placement
